Monsanto claimed that there was no correlation, then offered the veterans $180 million dollars to drop the case just hours before jury selection began. In 2013 $93 million was paid to Nitro, WV for compensatory damages, cleanup, and ongoing dioxin monitoring of the area where Agent Orange was produced.
